slides.heading: Worth an assessment if you notice

caption:
Koko felt a twinge during her rehab exercises and hasn't done them for a week. Does hurt always mean harm?

Pain is your body's protection system. It's shaped by sleep, stress, worry and past experience as well as what your tissues are doing, so it isn't a reliable damage meter on its own.

A practical guide many rehab programs use: mild pain during exercise, often up to 3 or 4 out of 10, that settles soon after is usually okay. Back to your usual by next morning? Carry on. Noticeably worse? Ease back one step rather than stopping everything.

Sudden severe pain, swelling, numbness, weakness or night pain are worth getting checked. Our team at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
